title: Select a specific mixer device in ALSA
summary: Control a specific mixer device (like a specific input or output stream) by name using alsamixer.

steps.explain: Launch alsamixer targeting a specific mixer device by its name.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the mixer device to control (e.g., 'default', 'hw:0,0').

steps.expect: The alsamixer interface opens showing controls for the specified device.
